experiment.selection: No arm/seed winner selection. Four fresh restored-context fits: uniform and bounded soft-ID weights at seeds17/29. Checkpoints minimize unweighted VAL joint NLL; risk/threshold selected on CAL only; all four arms reported on TEST.
experiment.primary_target: Unchanged v2 fixed crossing E/D; factorized BCE plus conditional direction CE, common known-root denominator. Risk grid never changes target.
experiment.context_contract: Regular 5s roots retained. Restored resets on date, clock gap or physical quote support transition only. Missing historical X has zero values and finite masks, clock_row_present=1 inside supported history; padding/support absent flag=0. No forward fill or time compression. No extra X channels.
experiment.weighting_contract: TRAIN known available roots only; count pooled long/short witness ID memberships including BOTH. Raw side m^-0.5; BOTH mean of both raw side weights; NONE=1. For each positive joint class solve sum clip(a*raw,0.5,2.0)=N_class by float64 monotone bisection. Bounds hold AFTER normalization; no clip-then-renormalize. Uniform permutations and mean weighted original BCE+conditional CE over root count. No IDs in X; unweighted VAL/TEST metrics.
experiment.feature_clock: 64 five-second roots; TCN RF61 = 300 seconds detailed history. Same 70 feature values and 141 model input channels in all arms.
experiment.day_context: Primary Micro omits day/VWAP/STFT channels. Rich 225 family retained as data artifact only, not fit in this experiment.
experiment.historical_exposure: The same dates, TEST outcomes, fitted predictions and results were previously inspected in scientific_pipeline_v3. The soft capped weighting hypothesis is motivated by V3 findings. This is a controlled follow-up on an exposed TEST block, not a fresh blind holdout. Older cognition experiments also assigned June to training and July to validation.
experiment.paired_diagnostics: Fresh uniform replays provide exact V3-restored controls. Same initial state, uniform batch order, scaler, cohort and probes per seed. Report paired soft-weight effects and descriptive whole-day intervals without TEST selection.

false_signal_protocol.side_true_positive: chosen side is a positive bit of y_crossing; BOTH qualifies either side
false_signal_protocol.wrong_side: y_crossing>0 and chosen side is absent from positive target bits
false_signal_protocol.primary_side_recall_denominator: All known X-admitted positive event roots; common across models
false_signal_protocol.none_false_positive: Selected alert on y_crossing=NONE; geometric false signal, not an execution loss

calibration_none_fpr.cohort: Known feature-available CAL NONE roots only
calibration_none_fpr.selection: Sort CAL NONE scores descending s[0..n-1], k=floor(0.05*n); threshold=np.nextafter(s[k],+inf) in float64
calibration_none_fpr.comparison: float64 score >= frozen float64 threshold; inclusive and conservative under ties
calibration_none_fpr.test_rule: Apply unchanged frozen CAL threshold to TEST; no positive TPR or TEST outcome used for fitting

fixed_test_execution_stress.role: Descriptive TEST stress only; never selects arm, seed, checkpoint, risk or policy
fixed_test_execution_stress.execution: Frozen original execution, costs and risk plans; partial/censored replay remains incomplete
